title: Incoming House Intelligence Chairman Vows Oversight of CIA’s Use of Covert Action
summary: Representative Jim Himes, who will run the powerful intelligence committee in the new Congress, said he also planned to scrutinize contractor donations to President Trump’s construction projects.
